verdict.rationale: n8n's own materials say workflows can include multi-step AI agents that use your own models and tools. Agent reasoning steps are shown on the canvas. Model choice is covered by connections to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models, plus Ollama and Groq credentials. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on agent and LLM node configuration and how tool calling works (the 'What agents do' and MCP Client entries are titles only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent and tool use inside workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: Build and operationalize AI workflows and multi-step agents using your own data, models, and tools
Connect to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source models and switch providers without changing your architecture
Every step of your agents' reasoning, traceable on the canvas.
Leverage these models to build AI-powered workflows.
